text:
Alyssa: starting intake for onboarding Orion-13B (hf/orion-13b-v1). Need a quick perf baseline + quant smoke + context-length sweep. Primary deliverables: p50/p95 latency at 256/1024/2048, throughput at batch sizes 1/4/8/16, and single-pass RLHF QA check for regressions.

Mohan: +1. Prioritize latency for low-latency tiers (batch1, seq<=1024). Also want a cheap int8 path if quality holds.

jia: I ran a short smoke locally on a single A100 (pad seq to 1024). Results: p50=45ms, p95=210ms for batch1, seq=1024, fp16. Throughput for batch8 seq1024 ~ 55 tok/s. Will push full sweep tonight.

perf-bot: perf summary (preliminary):
```
model: orion-13b-v1
fp16: batch1 seq256 p50=12ms p95=42ms
fp16: batch1 seq1024 p50=45ms p95=210ms
fp16: batch8 seq1024 throughput=55 toks/s
int8-quant: batch1 seq1024 p50=30ms p95=150ms (note: potential decode artifacts in fewshot tests)
```

sam: thanks. Can you capture KV cache hit behavior for streaming? We need to know warm vs cold latencies for prefix-cached flows.

jia: will do. Plan: run ctxlen sweep [128,256,512,1024,2048] x batches [1,4,8,16], for both fp16 and int8. Capture p50/p95, tail CPU load, GPU mem, and token throughput.

olga: for quality, add these evals: 100-shot HELM-style reasoning subset, 200 prompt paraphrase checks, and the existing regression set used for mistral/zephyr onboarding. Flag any >5% drop in exact match or >0.1 BLEU delta.

Alyssa: decision tree for next steps: if int8 p95 <= 1.2x fp16 p95 and quality deltas within thresholds -> promote int8 profile to candidate. Otherwise only ship fp16 and mark quant for tuning. Also record cost delta per-1000-tokens.

Mohan: one operational ask — record which kernel path is used (fused attention vs fallback) in each run. Add it to metadata. We saw different kernels change p95 a lot last quarter.

jia: noted. I'll collect kernel logs and perf counters. Using rbench command below for repeatability:
```
rbench --model hf/orion-13b-v1 --device a100:0 --seq 1024 --batch 8 --quant int8 --profile kernels,mem --runs 5 --out ./results/orion13b/seq1024_b8_int8.json
```

perf-bot: scheduling distributed sweep on dedicated infra tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Expect ~6h job.

sam: if distributed, add a run with interleaved small batches to simulate many small concurrent connections (e.g., 32x batch1 streams). We need to capture contention effects.

jia: good call — I'll include 32x1-stream test and a 4x8 mixed test. Also will capture latency histograms for streaming (per-token p50/p95/p99).

olga: reminder: add prompt set for safety/overgeneration checks. If int8 shows more hallucinations we cut it.

Alyssa: thanks team. Expected artifacts after sweep: 1) CSV of p50/p95/p99 per config, 2) throughput curves, 3) kernel map per run, 4) quality report (EM/BLEU/qual tags), 5) ops recommendation (promote int8 / tune / skip).

Mohan: timeline?

jia: full sweep + quality evals complete by EOD tomorrow. I'll post raw artifacts + tl;dr thread update.

Alyssa: perfect. Ping me when results are in and tag #eng-ml-onboarding. :rocket:
